title: feat(nfe1): sign(n_1) unique letter: reverse and face none
science: Selector sign(n_1) on the same kernel: n_1 = -1/3 at all four probes, so all four letters are `-` and reverse=face=`none`. The uniform sign is structural - every probe forms from a parent on its -e_1 side, so the occupancy kernel always points back along the causal parent and any sign-of-component readout is systematically biased against reverse (which needs L(A)=+).
